action.gmail.label: label an email “{label}” ({id})
action.gmail.trash: move an email to the trash ({id})
approval.suggest: You’ve allowed this 3 times. Always allow it, without asking?
catalog.externalHelp: External connector in {dir}. It runs as a separate process and only gets the variables below.
catalog.remoteHelp: Remote MCP server at {url}. It only gets what Pimpo sends it, with the headers below.
catalog.httpHelp: Described in connector.json, no program: Pimpo itself calls {url}, only the requests listed below, with the keys below.
msg.answer.gone: That question was already answered or has expired.
msg.answer.paused: Noted: {choice}. {name} is paused, so it will not act on it until you resume it.
msg.answer.pick: “{question}”: that is not one of the choices. Answer with one of them: {options}
credential.mail.title: Email
credential.refused: {title} did not accept the saved {field} and needs a new one.
credential.gone: This request was already answered, has expired, or is not yours.
credential.unreadable: The form could not be read.
credential.empty: Type the value first (up to 16 KB).
credential.failed: It could not be saved; try again.
msg.credential.ask: 🔑 {title} needs your {field}. Type it only in Pimpo's private form, never in a message: {link}
msg.credential.refused: 🔑 {title} did not accept your {field}. Give a new one only in Pimpo's private form, never in a message: {link}
msg.secret.removed: 🔒 That looked like a password or key, so I took it out before it went anywhere and did not keep it. Keys go only in Pimpo's private forms: Connections, or the link I send when something needs one.
msg.approval.always: Allowed. This won’t be asked again.
msg.approval.batch: Allowed for the rest of this run.
msg.approval.grant: Allowed for this routine: it will do exactly this again without asking. Anything different still asks. See Routines to take it back.
msg.approval.gone: This request is no longer waiting.
msg.approval.noGrant: Only the person a routine works for can approve it for that routine, and not this action. Answer once instead.
msg.audio.ready: 🎧 {title} (~{minutes} min) is ready. Listen in Pimpo, under Needs you.
msg.conv.new: 🆕 New conversation. What comes next starts fresh.
msg.effort.current: 🧠 This conversation’s thinking: {effort}. Options: {options}. Change it with /think <level>, or /think auto to let Pimpo choose.
msg.effort.set: ✅ From now on, this conversation thinks at {effort}.
msg.email.where: The result arrives on Telegram, WhatsApp or in Needs you.
msg.explore.noRoutine: This can’t become a routine because the data it needs couldn’t be read ({what}). Fix that and ask again.
msg.explore.offer: Turn this into a routine, without paying for a model every time?
msg.explore.simulated_one: ({count} action was only simulated; nothing was changed.)
msg.explore.simulated_other: ({count} actions were only simulated; nothing was changed.)
msg.link.unknownNotice: I no longer have that notice here. Answer it in the app, or reply to a newer one.
msg.link.noSuchChoice: That notice has no choice with that number.
msg.model.back: ✅ {model} is answering again and back in use.
msg.model.retired: ⚠️ {model} is no longer offered by its provider. Choose another model in Settings › Models.
msg.model.current: 🧠 This conversation’s model: {model}. Options: {options}. Change it with /model <name>, or /model auto to let Pimpo choose.
msg.model.fallback: ⚠️ {model} didn’t answer ({why}). Using {backup} for now; you’ll hear when it’s back.
msg.model.set: ✅ From now on, this conversation uses {model}.
msg.ownerOnly: Only the owner of the house can do that.
msg.pair.already: Pimpo is already connected here. Ask for something you do every week.
msg.pair.badCode: That code doesn’t match. Open Connections in Pimpo and use the code shown there.
msg.pair.link: Hi! Pimpo is connected here too. Ask for something you do every week.
msg.pair.linkBad: That code doesn’t match. See the pairing code in Connections.
msg.pair.owner:
Hi, {name}! Pimpo is connected. 👋

Ask for something you do every week, for example:
• “Every day at 7am, send me my calendar and the important emails”

The first time, Pimpo does it while you watch. After that, on its own.
msg.pair.person: Hi, {name}! You can now talk to the house’s Pimpo. Ask for something you do every week.
msg.pair.whatsapp: Hi! Pimpo is connected on WhatsApp too. Ask for something you do every week.
msg.pair.whatsappBad: That code doesn’t match. Get a new one in Connections or People.
msg.pair.whatsappPerson: Hi, {name}! You can now talk to the house’s Pimpo on WhatsApp.
msg.photo.ask: See what to do with this
msg.repo.changes_one: 📦 {count} routine changed in your repository. Its tests already ran; review and turn it on in Routines › Repository.
msg.repo.changes_other: 📦 {count} routines changed in your repository. Their tests already ran; review and turn them on in Routines › Repository.
msg.request.started: Got it. Working on it now; the result will arrive here. 🔎
msg.routine.redo: Redoing it with the agent; the result will arrive here.
msg.routine.reran: Ran again and it worked. Routine turned back on.
msg.upgrade: Pimpo was updated from {from} to {to}. A copy of everything as it was before is kept: if something looks wrong, go to Settings › Backup › Local copies and go back to it.
msg.dbDamaged: Pimpo's database failed its check, so today's copy was not made, so as not to replace a good one. Close and reopen Pimpo: it sets the damaged file aside and offers the newest good copy.
budget.person_over: Your own daily limit is reached ({spent} of {limit}); ask the administrator to raise it, or wait until tomorrow
limits.assistant_model: This assistant may not use {model}. Choose another model, or Automatic.
limits.no_model: There is no model you may use; ask the administrator to allow one for you.
limits.over_house: A person’s limit must be at most the house’s, {limit} a day.
limits.person_model: The administrator has not let you use {model}. Choose another model, or Automatic.
rule.preset-changes: Ask me before any change, even reversible ones.
rule.preset-delete: Deleting always becomes moving to the trash.
rule.preset-irreversible: Always ask me before anything that can’t be undone.
rule.preset-others: Only ask me before sending something to other people.
rule.preset-liberal: Ask me before sending anything to other people or anything that can’t be undone.
svc.apple.description: Apple's apps on this Mac: reminders that ring on the iPhone and Watch, notes and the calendar.
svc.apple.field.notes_folder.label: Notes folder
svc.apple.field.reminders_list.label: Default Reminders list
svc.apple.help: Give the Notes folder Pimpo writes in (created if missing) and, if you like, the default Reminders list. The first time, macOS asks to let Pimpo use each app: allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation.
svc.apple.title: Apple Reminders, Notes and Calendar
svc.discord.description: Alerts in a Discord channel of yours.
svc.discord.field.webhook.label: Webhook
svc.discord.help: In the channel, Edit channel › Integrations › Webhooks › New webhook, and copy the address.
svc.discord.title: Discord — alerts in a channel
svc.discordchat.description: Talk to Pimpo by private message on Discord.
svc.discordchat.field.token.label: Bot token
svc.discordchat.help: At discord.com/developers/applications, create an app, go to Bot, generate the token and invite the bot to a server of yours. Then send it, in a private message: pimpo and the pairing code from Connections.
svc.discordchat.title: Discord
svc.github.description: Issues and pull requests of your repositories.
svc.github.field.token.label: Token
svc.github.help: Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/tokens with read-only access to issues, and write access if Pimpo should comment.
svc.github.title: GitHub
svc.homeassistant.field.token.label: Long-lived token
svc.homeassistant.field.url.label: Home Assistant address
svc.homeassistant.help: In Home Assistant › Profile › Security, create a long-lived token. Locks, alarms, gates and valves always ask for your approval.
svc.homeassistant.title: Home Assistant
svc.notion.field.token.label: Integration token
svc.notion.help: Create an internal integration at notion.so/my-integrations and share with it only the pages Pimpo may see.
svc.notion.title: Notion
svc.obsidian.description: Your Markdown notes, in the vault folder.
svc.obsidian.field.vault.label: Vault folder
svc.obsidian.help: Give the vault folder on this computer. Before changing a note, Pimpo keeps a copy in .pimpo/history.
svc.obsidian.title: Obsidian
svc.rss.description: Reads news feeds, blogs and releases.
svc.rss.help: Nothing to set up: each routine declares the sites it may read.
svc.rss.title: RSS and Atom
svc.signal.description: Talk to Pimpo on Signal, encrypted up to this computer.
svc.signal.field.account.label: Pimpo’s number on Signal
svc.signal.field.url.label: signal-cli address
svc.signal.help: Install signal-cli, register or link a number and keep it running: signal-cli -a +NUMBER daemon --http 127.0.0.1:8080. Then send to that number, from your Signal: pimpo and the pairing code from Connections.
svc.signal.title: Signal
svc.slack.description: Alerts in a Slack channel of yours.
svc.slack.field.webhook.label: Webhook
svc.slack.help: Create an app at api.slack.com/apps with Incoming Webhooks for a channel of your own and paste the webhook address.
svc.slack.title: Slack — alerts in a channel
svc.slackchat.description: Talk to Pimpo by direct message on Slack.
svc.slackchat.field.app_token.label: App token (xapp-)
svc.slackchat.field.bot_token.label: Bot token (xoxb-)
svc.slackchat.help: At api.slack.com/apps, create an app, turn on Socket Mode (it creates the xapp- token with connections:write), subscribe to the message.im event, give the bot im:history, im:write and chat:write, and install it in the workspace. Then send the app, in a direct message: pimpo and the pairing code from Connections. For routines that react to Slack, also subscribe to message.channels and app_mention, give the bot channels:history and app_mentions:read, and add the app to the channels.
svc.slackchat.title: Slack
svc.todoist.description: Your tasks: read, create and complete.
svc.todoist.field.token.label: API token
svc.todoist.help: In Todoist › Settings › Integrations › Developer, copy the API token.
svc.todoist.title: Todoist
svc.websearch.description: Searches the internet: news, prices, opening hours, anything.
svc.websearch.field.brave_key.label: Brave Search API key
svc.websearch.field.perplexity_key.label: Perplexity API key
svc.websearch.field.searxng_url.label: SearXNG address
svc.websearch.help: Use the Brave Search API (free key at api-dashboard.search.brave.com, 2,000 searches a month), Perplexity's search (key at perplexity.ai/account/api, about US$5 per thousand searches, billed by Perplexity) or the address of a SearXNG instance of yours or one you trust, with the JSON format on. If you fill in more than one, this order applies: Brave, Perplexity, SearXNG.
svc.websearch.title: Web search
msg.budgetOver: The day's spending limit ran out.
msg.suggestion.gone: That suggestion is no longer there.
msg.suggestion.started: Started: I am doing it once while you watch; approve it to turn it into a routine.
msg.suggestion.declined: OK, I will not suggest that again.
msg.lessons.digest: 📚 {count} lessons to review: things Pimpo noticed and would keep. Accept, edit or reject each one in Pimpo › Lessons.
msg.job.done:
🧩 Job finished: {request}
Cost ${cost}. The report is in Trabalhos.
msg.progress.resumed: picked up again after a restart
msg.link.approveElsewhere: To choose, use the Pimpo app or another channel; this one never approves anything.
svc.imessage.title: iMessage
svc.imessage.description: Talk to Pimpo on iMessage, on a Mac.
svc.imessage.help: Mac only. Sign in to Messages with an Apple ID (ideally one just for Pimpo) and give Pimpo Full Disk Access in System Settings › Privacy & Security, so it can read the messages that arrive. Then send to that Apple ID, from your iPhone: pimpo and the pairing code from Connections.
svc.imessage.field.account.label: Pimpo’s Apple ID in Messages
svc.wapersonal.title: Personal WhatsApp (unofficial)
svc.wapersonal.description: Talk to Pimpo on your own WhatsApp number, through an unofficial bridge.
svc.wapersonal.help: Warning: WhatsApp does not allow this. The number can be banned and the bridge stops working without notice when WhatsApp changes. Use a number you can lose; the official WhatsApp (Business) in Connections has no such risk. It works only with Labs › Personal WhatsApp on, and it never approves anything: choices wait for the app or another channel. Run WAHA (github.com/devlikeapro/waha) on this computer, sign in with the QR code and send to that number: pimpo and the pairing code from Connections.
svc.wapersonal.field.url.label: WAHA address
svc.wapersonal.field.session.label: Session
svc.wapersonal.field.api_key.label: WAHA API key
